summary.intent: Execute all 9 plans of CipherBox phase 71 (Share-Invite Security & IPNS Data-Integrity API) via wave-based parallel subagent execution, then run a fully autonomous post-execution ship pipeline (verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit → PR → resolve reviews) to get the phase merge-ready without babysitting.
summary.outcome: All 9 plans executed across 4 waves, merged, and verified (16/16 truths, 0 gaps); phase 71 marked complete. The ship pipeline then passed security/validation, found and fixed a real regression in the D-05 IPNS equivocation guard and a Greptile-flagged stale-write-key bug in the widen-only claim merge, triaged CodeRabbit findings, opened PR #599 with a conventional title, and was mid-way through resolving PR review threads (fixing the Greptile P1) when the transcript ends.

repo: cipher-box is a pnpm monorepo; root `pnpm typecheck` excludes `apps/api tsc --noEmit`, so pre-existing tsc errors there are non-CI-gated noise, not regressions
Local dev stack ports: postgres 5432, redis 6380, kubo (IPFS) 5001, mock-ipns-routing 3001, tee-worker 3002, API 3000

sdk-e2e reads `SDK_E2E_SECRET` (default `e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production`) but vitest does not auto-load `.env`; API's `TEST_LOGIN_SECRET` must be passed explicitly or auth 401s cascade-skip whole suites

Repo is squash-merge only (`merge:false, rebase:false, squash:true`) — individual commit subjects never reach main, only the PR title needs to be conventional/paren-free; commitlint's subject-no-parens rule is enforced solely via `pr-title.yml`, not per-commit
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL incompatibility; use `gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file` instead
Worktree base-check reason `baseref-head` means worktrees fork from live HEAD, allowing parallel wave execution without inter-wave degrade
codebase-drift advisory gate flags ~143 pre-existing structural elements as noise because the repo was never `/gsd-map-codebase`'d (`last_mapped_commit: null`)
CodeRabbit CLI review caps at 150 changed files (this phase's 106 was under the cap)

The API does not log handled 4xx bodies; to see the real reason for a 400/409, temporarily add an axios response interceptor in `packages/api-client/src/instance.ts`, rebuild the client chain, run once, then revert

code.finding: D-05 same-sequence CID-equivocation guard fired 400 on legitimate concurrent CAS races (embeddedSeq === dbSeq but caller intended a forward-CAS that lost the race); fixed by falling through to the CAS UPDATE (→409) when `expectedSequenceNumber === embeddedSeq - 1`, confirmed via `rotation-crash-safety` sdk-e2e suite going from 5/6 to 6/6

Widen-only merge in claimInvite: a generation-bump re-claim via a write-capable invite onto an already-write-capable share advanced the read key/generation but left `encryptedWriteKey` wrapped for the stale generation, silently losing write access post-rotation (Greptile P1); fixed and unit-tested
Permission derivation used `!== null` on a `string | null | undefined` write-key field, misclassifying `undefined` as a write grant; loosened to `!= null` in both occurrences

Pre-existing crypto-hygiene gap: if the second `unwrapKey` call throws, the first unwrapped key is outside the try block so `finally` never zeroizes it — flagged by CodeRabbit, deferred as todo since it predates phase 71

workflow: Running independent audit agents (security, Nyquist validation) as parallel background tasks while doing a read-only simplify pass in the foreground overlaps well and shortens the ship pipeline's critical path
When an SDK E2E suite fails, classify each failure against `git diff origin/main` before deciding fix vs defer — distinguishes real phase regressions from pre-existing/environmental breakage
Reproduce a suspected regression at least twice before diagnosing it as deterministic, to rule out flakiness in concurrency-sensitive tests
Prefer capturing todos for out-of-scope, risky, or behavior-changing review findings rather than fixing everything a linter/reviewer surfaces at ship time

friction: The tracking-commit helper repeatedly reported `commit_failed` while the commit actually landed (known false-negative, required manual `git log` verification each time)
First PR-review poll script had an awk parsing bug against tab-delimited `gh pr checks` output, causing a false 'still pending' read that had to be corrected and re-run

A user-approved local Postgres DB reset (to get a clean live-stack run for the 71-05 checkpoint) had a collateral side effect of wiping `tee_key_state`, causing 2 unrelated sdk-e2e `tee-republish` test failures later in the ship gate
A stale `node dist/main.js` API process was already listening on :3000 from an earlier session and had to be killed/rebuilt from current code before the 71-05 live-stack checkpoint could be trusted
CodeRabbit misread the phase's `SECURITY.md` (claimed it referenced vaults when it correctly referenced `ipns_records`), producing an invalid finding that had to be manually verified and dismissed
A secret-pattern guard blocked direct `grep` of `.env` files, requiring an alternate source-only investigation path to confirm throttle-bypass behavior
